tagline.en: Keno, Tower, Cross the Road and Pump are live.
tagline.id: Keno, Tower, Cross the Road, dan Pump sudah bisa dimainkan.

items.en: Keno: pick up to 10 numbers, 10 balls are drawn.
items.id: Keno: pilih sampai 10 angka, 10 bola diundi.

items.en: Tower, Cross the Road and Pump: go one step further or cash out. Four difficulties each.
items.id: Tower, Cross the Road, dan Pump: maju satu langkah lagi atau cash out. Masing-masing empat tingkat kesulitan.

items.en: Every result is decided on the server and stays provably fair.
items.id: Semua hasil ditentukan di server dan tetap provably fair.

items.en: No more random sign-outs. The anti-bot check now sits only on the sign-in, sign-up and reset forms.
items.id: Tidak ada lagi ter-logout tiba-tiba. Cek anti-bot sekarang hanya ada di form login, daftar, dan reset password.
